title: MT69303: Computational Metallurgy Laboratory
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

1.Assignments related to basics of C- Programming2.Solution of a set of linear
algebraic equations and application to metallurgical reactor design3.Solution
of a set of non-linear equations and application to thermodynamic
problem4.Solutions of a set of ordinary differential equation and application
to chemical kinetics of Metallurgical reactions5.Solution of a transient, one
dimensional heat conduction equation with temperature dependent properties
related to heat treatment problem6.Solution of multidimensional diffusive
partial differential equation related to heat and mass transfer in
Metallurgical system7.Solution of one/two dimensional convective diffusive
equation for solving simplified liquid system in Metallurgy
